desc: Ruger has always been associated with quality and the officially licensed The Ruger® Summit Ultralite gun sling is no exception. Made with low density foam, covered by rugged fabric this Ultralite gun sling will take what the elements will throw at it. It comes with a non-slip textured back, the Ruger® Summit Ultralite Gun Sling is lightweight and durable. The gun sling itself is constructed with heavy duty web material, and the swivels are tested to 300 pounds.
